title: Stacey N
content: On April 12, 2023, I gave birth to my son. I pushed for a total of eight minutes and a healthy baby was put on my chest. Shortly afterward, I heard my OBGYN say, 'Oh no, it happened again!' She was referring to was my placenta was being retained because my placenta grew into my uterine wall. This also had happened with the birth of my other daughter two years prior. In that instance, my doctor didn't have any issues getting the placenta out. This time, she did. The room was extremely chaotic because I requested to not be put on fentanyl, the pain drug that was given to me in 2021 that made me very sick. So, we had to wait for the anesthesiologist to administer c-section grade pain killers. When he arrived, it was a slow process to add this medicine to the IV. My OBGYN was growing frustrated and was arguing with him about how she needed to start working to remove my placenta. Once the pain medicine was given to me, they started pushing on my abdomen hoping that action would help push things out. My son was taken away because it was dangerous for him to be on my chest and breastfeed. I remember being very upset about this. Then I blacked out. I was suddenly hovering over my body looking down at the room. I remember this because there was no way I would've been able to see my baby in the bassinet from where I was lying on my hospital bed. But, I was able to see him clearly in the bassinet. I felt myself being forced back into my body. I must have arrived back with a jolt because I threw up on myself. I had lost a lot of blood and it was being discussed if I should have a blood transfusion. After hours of trying to get all of the placenta out, my doctor said she was finished. Three weeks later, it was discovered that I still had a third of my placenta left inside of me. I needed a DNC procedure to remove the rest of it. Shortly after, I was diagnosed with PTSD and PPD and underwent EMDR to help. The imagery of the birth doesn't loop in my brain anymore. Even when I think of it, the images have faded. Yet, the only thing that I vividly remember is hovering over my body and looking around the room.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Childbirth, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, It felt like being a kid sneaking out of the house—you knew you shouldn't be doing it and wondered if you'd get caught. I was alert to every noise and movement in a way I had never experienced before. I also felt as though I was in the wrong, as if I shouldn't have been hovering there.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I don't think the event lasted long; it felt like I was at my highest level of consciousness and alertness for the entire duration.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual, Everything appeared to be moving at a normal pace, but I felt like I was moving slower. It took me longer than usual to take in the entire room.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I felt as though I was simply observing myself from above; my vision remained the same.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I didn't hear anything during the experience.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt like I shouldn't have been doing what I was doing. It felt as though it wasn’t my time and that someone was pushing me back.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will, It felt as though I was being pushed back into my body.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Catholic, I was raised Catholic.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I am now certain that there is an afterlife.
elements.What is your religion now?: Other faiths- New age, I believe there is an afterlife where, instead of God, there are people who help us move on to our next life.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I knew an afterlife existed, but I didn't really know to what extent.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I now believe that there is an afterlife where we learn and develop before being reborn.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, I sensed someone nearby who was ensuring that I returned to my body. It felt like I was being pushed back down to Earth.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, I was meant to survive to raise my children.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I felt my grandmother's presence even though she had passed away two years earlier. I believe she pushed me back to my body.
Yes, I am not sure if it was specific information or explicitly stated, but I knew I was being sent back because of my son and daughter.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I gained the ability to talk to spirits in the after world. I knew my grandmother was trying to communicate with me in December 2023. I woke up to inexplicable flashing lights and then had a dream about her. Later, I awoke to the sound of a jewelry box, even though no one was playing with one, in the middle of the night. Finally, I woke up to see a dark shadow and felt a hovering presence over my body; afterward, I had another dream about my grandmother. Although she never appeared directly in my dreams, we were always talking about her or being in her house. I consulted a medium, who confirmed that my grandmother was trying to communicate with me. She said that my grandmother wanted to tell me she was proud of me for surviving what I went through and that there was a reason for the events. The medium also mentioned that I had the ability to connect with spirits, though she didn't provide further details. Then, in January 2025, I felt compelled to see a medium known for training people who believed they had the power to connect with spirits. She gave me tools for connecting with spirits, and that evening, spirits began appearing to me. I was able to sense who they were and ask yes-or-no questions to understand what they wanted. I felt guided to ask certain questions. It felt as if I were zoning out, looking into the distance, and watching answers appear in my mind. I have read that deeply traumatic events can cause people to open up in this way, and I believe that is why I was meant to go through the trauma. Through talking with spirits, I believe I can confidently say that there is an afterlife and that there are guides who help us transition through it. We learn from our mistakes and are able to progress in a better direction in our next life. I have always had a phobia of blood. I remember, when I was five, watching a movie in which a man was attacked by a woman in an insane asylum. Despite having very detailed images in my mind of that movie, no one else has been able to identify it. Recently, while lying in bed, I saw myself as a nurse in a 1950s hospital, discovering a man whose head was bleeding and watching my patient run away. I think that when I was five, I experienced past-life imagery that I later confused with a movie. This experience was the first step toward unlocking the ability in my brain to connect with spirits.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I can replay this memory in my brain like a movie reel. I remember the placement of everyone in the room and what they were doing, which is not typical of my everyday life.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I have the ability to communicate with spirits.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I always knew I wanted to have children. I had no idea that raising them would be the reason I was meant to stay on Earth. I truly believe my kids are destined to do great things, and I was sent back to help them achieve that.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was probably real, Bits and pieces of what happened during the birth of my son started coming back to me. I remembered fragments of the experience. I am not sure what triggered the memory, but I suddenly knew I had left my body, and the memory began flooding back.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I knew it was real because I clearly saw my son during the experience and felt a very strong pull toward him. However, while lying on my hospital bed, I was unable to see him.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I'm grateful for it. It opened up a world I never knew I'd be able to communicate with. Being able to share comments and words from a loved one who has passed is truly amazing.
